name: roomba
about: VAC-COP: an armoured police-enforcer disc (the MEGA VAC-COP is the same model at 2.6x). Faces -Z, radius 0.5 m. Groups the game uses: Body (flashes when shot), Cap, Bumper, Eye (the cyclops visor: glows + is the crit WEAK SPOT), SirenRed, SirenBlue, Brush, Brush2 (pivot = middle, spun by roomba.gd). Made by tools/make_creature_specs.py.
